verdict.rationale: Streams record table DML changes so actions can be taken on the changed data, which enables incremental processing. Dynamic tables are listed as GA in the release notes. dbt Projects on Snowflake lets engineers develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe transformations on managed runtimes inside the platform, and a community user confirms running dbt incremental models on Snowflake. Snowpipe continuously loads arriving files, supporting the continuous side. Missing for 10: any evidence of tasks or scheduling for consuming streams, substantive docs on dynamic tables beyond a release-note title, and documented end-to-end continuous or declarative pipeline behavior (refresh/lag semantics)
